description: This file defines a React hook and context provider for authentication management in an admin panel, supporting both mock/localStorage and Supabase sessions. It handles user login, logout, session management, and admin role determination based solely on a 'public.admins' table, removing previous role-based checks.

classes.name: AuthContext
classes.description: React context for authentication state and helpers.

methods.name: isNoRowsFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error from Supabase indicates no rows found, used to determine non-admin status.

methods.name: computeIsAdminFromAdminsTable
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the current user is an admin by querying the 'public.admins' table.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component providing authentication context, managing user state, session, and admin status.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context within React components.
